meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以借助 bioservices 这个 Python 工具，查询和比对 40 多个生物数据库（如蛋白质、通路、化合物等），在不同库之间转换标识符，并运行 BLAST 序列比对。工具会统一处理各种网络接口，直接返回结构化结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求在一个工作流里同时查询多个生物数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等），或需要进行跨库 ID 映射时触发。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use the bioservices Python package to query 40+ bioinformatics databases (e.g., protein sequences, pathways, compounds), convert identifiers across databases, and run BLAST searches. It handles REST and SOAP protocols and returns structured results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to query multiple biological databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, etc.) in a single workflow, or needs cross-database ID mapping. Also suitable for pathway and GO queries.
